items.headline: John Alan Richter tosses 4 TDs as Toledo rallies past Temple 49-48 in overtime
items.description: — John Alan Richter threw for 429 yards and four touchdowns as Toledo erased a 14-point deficit late in regulation to beat Temple 49-48 in overtime on Saturday.

items.headline: John Alan Richter throws for 3 TDs as Toledo pummels Central Connecticut 63-10
items.description: — John Alan Richter threw for 252 yards and three touchdowns as Toledo scored 56 straight points in a 63-10 win over Central Connecticut on Saturday in the Rockets’ home opener.
